item.title: Pretty pocket doors! Circa 1900 in Arizona. $309,500
item.description: There are some pretty pocket doors and vintage light fixtures inside this house! The home was built in 1900. It is located in Winslow, Arizona. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, pretty pocket doors, vintage light fixtures, baseboards, crown moulding and stained glass. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,904 square feet. $309,500 Contact Carolyn Rice with West USA Realty From the Zillow listing: Timeless 5-Bedroom Retreat Near Route 66 – Original Craftsmanship Meets M

item.title: Nice interior! Circa 1920. Over an acre in Arkansas. $185,000
item.description: This house has a nice interior! Big yard too! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 1.05 acres in Osceola, Arkansas. The house features a porte cochere, pretty wood floors, original windows, vintage light fixtures, baseboards, crown moulding, french doors, built-in china cabinet, spacious kitchen and a large sunroom. There is a detached garage and a detached storage shed on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,167 square feet. $185,000 Contact Rena Brown with 1st Choice Realt

item.title: So cute! Look inside! Circa 1937 in California. $259,000
item.description: This is so cute! Love the interior! Would make a great vacation spot! The house was built in 1937. It is located in Lake Arrowhead, California. The house features a large deck, vaulted ceiling, loft area, wood stove, exposed beams and baseboards. The home is close to local amenities, outdoor activities, dining and shopping. One bedroom, one bathroom and 472 square feet. $259,000 Contact Alyssa Wenz with Vista Sotheby’s: 951-684-1300 From the Zillow listing: Back on Market at No Fault to Seller!

item.title: Pretty stairs and stained glass! Circa 1889 in Colorado. $299,000
item.description: This house has a pretty staircase! The bottom is rather unique. Love the stained glass windows! The house was built in 1889. It is located on .28 acre in Trinidad, Colorado. The house features a wrought iron fence, covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, stained glass windows, baseboards, vintage light fixtures, spacious kitchen, crown moulding and pocket doors. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,234 square feet. $299,000 Contact Gina Raye with Authentic Colorado Properties: 719-680

item.title: $179,900! Four acres in Connecticut. Apple trees and blueberry bushes! C. 1785.
item.description: There are 50-60 mature blueberry bushes on this property! 200 year old apple trees also. The listing says this house has foundation issues. At first glance, I’m not seeing anything glaringly obvious. Going to guess there is a basement and that is where it’s most noticeable. The house was built in 1785. item.title: Porch goals! Beautiful front door! C. 1885 in North Carolina. $279,000
item.description: Porch goals! I love the front door! There are pretty details inside! Known as the Long-Haislip house. The house was built in 1885. It is located on .64 acre in Hamilton, North Carolina. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, nice staircase, wide baseboards, crown moulding, arched entryway, ceiling medallions and crystal chandelier. There are two outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,910 square feet. $279,000 Contact Nancy Winslow wit

item.title: Former Civil War Field Hospital and Church. C. 1839. Three acres in Virginia. $525,000
item.description: There is a lot of history with this building! It started off as an Episcopal Church. During the Civil War it was used as a field hospital. In the 1950’s it was abandoned and left vacant. It was built in 1839. It is located on three acres in Goochland, Virginia. The church has been converted into a private residence. It features wide plank wood floors, built-in bookshelves, wainscoting, tall ceilings and exposed beams. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,246 square feet. $525,000 Contact Eliza Co

item.title: Pretty details! Nice stained glass! Two acres in Georgia. $245,000
item.description: This house has some pretty details! A lot of stained glass too. The house was built in 1899. It is located on 2.02 acres in Douglasville, Georgia. The house features a large covered front porch, upper porch, wood floors, stained glass windows, baseboards, picture rails, crystal chandeliers and an updated kitchen. There are a couple of storage sheds on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,292 square feet. $245,000 Contact Jennifer Cadwell with Sky High Realty From the Zillow listing:

item.title: Beautiful setting! Hummingbird Hills, on 66 acres in Idaho. $899,000
item.description: This is such a beautiful setting! Would be nice to have that much acreage. Hummingbird Hills was built in 1863. It is located on 66.98 acres in Garden Valley, Idaho. The house features a large deck, hot tub, wood floors, baseboards, buffet seating, wood stove and a large pantry. The property has a pond and a dock. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,590 square feet. $899,000 Contact Marta Paulson with A. V. West: 208-608-1880 From the Zillow listing: Garden Valley Homestead established 1863 on 6

item.title: Pretty stained glass! Former St. John’s Church. On 2 1/2 acres in Illinois. $125,000
item.description: Unique looking former church! Originally the St. John’s church. It was built in 1919. It is located on 2.5 acres in Aledo, Illinois. The church is now zoned residential. There is a large room with vaulted ceiling, some wood floors and pretty stained glass. Love the room with all of the stained glass windows. 4,996 square feet. $125,000 Contact Brittney Mills with Mel Foster: 309-798-8647 From the Zillow listing: BACK ON THE MARKET ! What an incredible opportunity to own a piece of history! Forme
